ὠτάριον, -ου, τό 
= ὠτίον (which see), 
the ear: Mrk.14.47, Jhn.18.10.†
(AS)

δύσις, -εως, ἡ 
(δύνω), [in LXX: Psa.104.19 (מָבוֹא) * ;] 
__1. a sinking, setting, as of the sun (Æsch.): Mrk.16.1-20 [alt. ending]. 
__2. the sun-setting, the west (Thuc.).†
(AS)

ἐκ-βαίνω, 
[in LXX for עָלֶה ;] 
to go out: Heb.11.15.†
(AS)

σιρός, see: σειρός.
σειρός 
(σιρός, T), -οῦ, ὁ (Rec., R, mg., σειρά, which see), = cl. σιρός, 
a pit for the storage of grain: σειροὶ ζόφου, 2Pe.2.4, WH, R., txt. (but see Mayor, in l; Field, Notes, 241).†
(AS)

αὐχέω, -ῶ, 
(αὔχη, boasting), 
to boast: with accusative (MM, see word), μεγάλα αὐχεῖ (Rec. μεγαλαυχεῖ, which see), Jas.3.5.†
(AS)
burn to ashes, destroy by fire (2Pe.2.6 - variant P72*)
comb, clean (of wool; Mat.6.28 - variant א*)
